title: TRICARE Select Coverage Months and TRICARE Prime Catch-Up Billing
content:
A beneficiary whose TRICARE Prime enrollment was restored may have held a TRICARE Select enrollment during part of the restored span. Months of the TRICARE Prime catch-up installment that TRICARE Select coverage holds or touches are billed differently.

## Reading TRICARE Select coverage

TRICARE Select coverage is read from the beneficiary's TRICARE Select enrollment - its effective date and its disenrollment date:

- a month lies **wholly inside** it when it falls after the month containing the Select effective date and before the month containing the Select disenrollment date, or, where the Select enrollment has no disenrollment date, when it falls after the month containing the Select effective date;
- a month is **touched** by it when it contains the Select effective date or the Select disenrollment date.

## Rule for each month the catch-up would bill

| TRICARE Select coverage and the month | Treatment |
|---|---|
| Select coverage holds the month wholly | the month is left out - its monthly rate comes off |
| Select coverage only touches the month | the month is billed less Select's monthly share |
| otherwise | the month is billed in full |

What TRICARE Select's coverage takes off is the months left out at the monthly rate plus the touched months at Select's monthly share, rounded to the cent. Only months the catch-up would bill are weighed; a month the catch-up does not bill takes nothing off.

## Worked months (hypothetical)

TRICARE Select effective 15 May, disenrolled 10 August; the catch-up would bill April through September at a monthly rate of 32.51; Select's monthly share is 25.00.

| Month | Relation to Select coverage | Comes off |
|---|---|---|
| April | none | nothing |
| May | touched (contains the effective date) | 25.00 |
| June | wholly inside | 32.51 |
| July | wholly inside | 32.51 |
| August | touched (contains the disenrollment date) | 25.00 |
| September | none | nothing |

Taken off in all: 115.02. Had the same TRICARE Select enrollment no disenrollment date, May would be touched and June through September wholly inside: 25.00 plus 4 times 32.51, 155.04 taken off.
